base: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original pixel-art animation sprite atlas for GymBeast matching the exact five ages of the attached character reference. Reference roles: character identity only. The five characters LEFT TO RIGHT in the reference are BABY, CHILD, ADOLESCENT, ADULT, TITAN. Do not include the labels or reference background. Preserve faces, species anatomy, colors, markings and silhouette per age; the result must be recognizable as the SAME companion. Output exactly TWO equal width COLUMNS by FIVE ROWS on portrait canvas: row1 baby, row2 child, row3 adolescent, row4 adult, row5 titan. Each row contains LEFT starting pose and RIGHT ending pose of one exercise. Fully hatched, no egg shells. Transparent background, no matte, no aura, no glow, no shadows on floor, no environment, no words, no borders or grid. Leave generous blank transparent gaps between rows and columns. All limbs/equipment inside their cells. Smaller babies and growing adults within equal cells. Same body size, camera, equipment and feet position in each pair; only exercised joints move. Crisp pixel clusters and dark pixel outlines. Use forepaws to grip, phoenix grips with articulated wing tips; never human faces. Only the character and necessary equipment. Titan retains markings/armor. Movement:

movements.bench: Use image 2 TOP ROW ONLY as the exact anatomical pose and camera reference for a FLAT BENCH PRESS. Image 2 bottom row is irrelevant. Replace the human with the species and age from image1. Side view, HEAD AT LEFT, FEET AT RIGHT, entire BACK HORIZONTAL on flat bench. Face looks UP to ceiling. Hips and knees flexed, feet BELOW bench resting on floor. NEVER sitting, never upright, never overhead shoulder press. Two separate shoulders at left edge of torso; far shoulder shifted slightly toward right to show a separate FAR arm. LEFT frame both arms extend VERTICALLY above CHEST, hands separated across the DEPTH of the bar, close hand slightly left and far hand slightly right (visible perspective), not both originating from the same shoulder. RIGHT frame bar at mid chest, elbows bent to either side, no crossing. Side-view barbell has plates at front and far end, not a bar behind head. Exactly follow the top two human exercise poses while keeping exact character identity. The straight body lies horizontally the whole time. FIVE age rows TWO poses each.
movements.lunge: Holding two dumbbells at sides in a long staggered split stance. LEFT tall split stance, RIGHT front knee bent 90 degrees rear knee near floor. Both feet fixed, neutral torso, tail clear, not a squat with feet together.
movements.squat: Barbell across upper back, both feet shoulder width flat, back neutral. LEFT standing tall, RIGHT deep squat hips back knees flexed. Bar tracks over midfoot. Same camera/feet.
movements.deadlift: Barbell very close to legs, arms straight throughout. LEFT neutral-back hip hinge with bar at mid-shin and soft knees. RIGHT standing tall, hips extended bar against thighs. Same grip/feet.
movements.pulldown: Seated at lat pulldown cable machine with thigh pad, wide overhand grip. LEFT bar overhead arms extended, RIGHT bar in front of upper chest with elbows pointing down. Fixed seat and torso.
movements.hip-thrust: Shoulders supported on low bench, feet flat, knees bent, padded barbell across hips. LEFT hips lowered, RIGHT shoulders-hips-knees aligned horizontally. Feet/shoulders remain fixed.
movements.leg-press: Seated in reclined 45-degree leg press machine, back supported, feet fixed on raised sled platform, hands hold seat. LEFT knees bent platform close, RIGHT legs extended but knees soft platform farther away. Maintain fixed seat and realistic rail.
movements.pull-up: Hanging from fixed overhead horizontal bar. LEFT straight arms feet off ground. RIGHT chin above bar elbows flexed. Same bar position; body moves upwards, no wings flying.
movements.dumbbell-press: Incline DUMBBELL CHEST PRESS on a bench at ONLY 20 degrees above horizontal. Body almost horizontal, face looks upward. Feet below bench supported on ground, NOT sitting upright. LEFT forearms vertical above upper chest, two dumbbells side by side, RIGHT elbows bent dumbbells beside chest. Separate shoulders, wrist above elbows. No shoulder press. Fixed bench, grip, body, feet. Equipment and all ages must occupy at most 70% of each cell, including the TITAN.
movements.curl: Standing dumbbell biceps curl with one dumbbell in each forepaw, upper arms fixed beside ribs. LEFT elbows extended hands near thighs; RIGHT elbows flexed hands near shoulders, palms supinated. No barbell, no bench. Fixed feet, neutral back.
movements.row: Bent-over barbell row, neutral spine and hips hinged, knees soft. LEFT arms extended bar below shoulders, RIGHT bar pulled close to lower ribs elbows back, unchanged torso/feet.
movements.seated-row: Seated cable row with feet on machine supports and neutral torso. LEFT arms extended handles ahead, RIGHT handles at waist with elbows back. No torso rocking, same machine.
movements.t-row: Chest-supported T-bar row with chest against inclined pad and feet supported. LEFT arms extended bar below chest, RIGHT handle drawn to lower ribs elbows back. Fixed support.
movements.fly: Supine flat bench dumbbell chest fly. LEFT arms open wide at chest height with softly bent elbows, RIGHT dumbbells together above chest. Same elbow softness, bench and body.
movements.pec-deck: Seated chest fly machine with chest upright against backrest, forepaws on handles. LEFT arms wide to sides, RIGHT handles meet in front of chest. Same seat and body.
movements.pullover: Supine across a flat bench, holding one dumbbell with both forepaws. LEFT dumbbell above chest arms almost straight, RIGHT dumbbell arcs behind head with slight fixed elbow bend. Same bench/body.
movements.rear-delt: Reverse pec-deck machine, seated facing chest pad, torso supported. LEFT handles together in front shoulders, RIGHT handles opened laterally arms near horizontal. No shoulder press.
movements.lateral-raise: Standing dumbbell lateral raise. LEFT dumbbells beside thighs, RIGHT arms out to sides at shoulder height elbows softly bent. Fixed feet and torso.
movements.front-raise: Standing front raise holding a round weight plate in two forepaws. LEFT plate at thighs, RIGHT plate straight ahead at shoulder height. Neutral back.
movements.calf-raise: Standing calf raise with dumbbells by sides. LEFT heels resting on low step, RIGHT heels lifted tiptoes, knees nearly straight. Step and feet stay fixed.
movements.leg-curl: Seated hamstring curl machine, back supported, padded roller near ankles. LEFT knees almost extended, RIGHT knees bent bringing roller down under seat. Same seat/hips.
movements.lying-curl: Prone lying leg curl machine, belly supported, padded roller above heels. LEFT legs almost straight, RIGHT knees bent with heels toward glutes. Fixed hips/bench.
movements.leg-extension: Seated leg extension machine, back supported, roller across front of ankles. LEFT knees bent 90 degrees, RIGHT knees extended raising roller. Fixed seat/thighs.
movements.abductor: Seated hip abduction machine, knees against outer thigh pads. LEFT thighs near parallel, RIGHT knees open outwards against pads. Fixed feet/body.
movements.dip: Parallel bar dip with forepaws holding fixed bars, feet suspended and knees soft. LEFT elbows extended holding body high, RIGHT elbows bent about90 degrees body lowered, torso slightly forward.
movements.pushdown: Standing triceps cable pushdown using straight short bar attached overhead. Upper arms fixed at ribs. LEFT elbows bent bar near upper belly, RIGHT elbows extended bar at thighs. No shoulder movement.
movements.french-press: Supine on flat bench, triceps skullcrusher with two dumbbells. Upper arms point upwards. LEFT elbows bent dumbbells either side of head, RIGHT elbows extended dumbbells above shoulders. Fixed shoulders/bench.
movements.overhead-extension: Seated dumbbell overhead triceps extension holding one dumbbell with both forepaws. LEFT elbows bent dumbbell behind head, RIGHT elbows extended dumbbell above head. Upper arms stay beside head.
movements.barbell-curl: Standing barbell biceps curl with forepaws shoulder width apart. LEFT bar at thighs elbows extended, RIGHT bar close to lower chest elbows flexed, upper arms fixed ribs. Uncrossed arms.
movements.incline-curl: Seated on inclined bench with back supported, dumbbell in each forepaw. LEFT arms hang straight below shoulders, RIGHT elbows flexed dumbbells lifted toward shoulders without moving upper arms.
movements.hammer-curl: Standing dumbbell hammer curl, palms facing inwards throughout. LEFT arms extended dumbbells near thighs, RIGHT forearms bent dumbbells toward shoulders. Upper arms fixed ribs.
movements.plank: Forearm plank on a small exercise mat, elbows below shoulders and toes grounded, neutral aligned head-spine-hips. Two very subtly different breathing poses only; never lift hips or bend spine.
movements.walk: Walking on a flat treadmill, upright relaxed posture. LEFT left hind leg forward and right forepaw forward, RIGHT opposite stride. Same treadmill/location. Wings folded; no flying.

paddingCorrection: IMPORTANT: Correct the old crowded layout. Each of the TEN cells has 20% completely transparent padding on all four sides. Scale down EACH entire character AND equipment together. In particular the TITAN on the last row must have at least 50px transparent space BELOW the full equipment and tail. Never touch a cell edge. Keep the equipment identical in both poses.
notes: The final bench assets use the second pose reference. Dragon dip, dumbbell-press and leg-curl were regenerated with the padding correction. Earlier rejected seated bench generations are not the final assets.
